Collaboration LOG IN TO SUGGEST IMPROVEMENTS DISTORTION BOOSTER OVERDRIVE COMPRESSOR VIBRATO Description Buzzing Bugs Audio Devices proudly presents our newest creation, Mortal Joy, in collaboration with the UK’s “first and only emo band”, Los Campesinos! Mortal Joy is a dirt and modulation pedal designed to recreate the guitar sounds on Los Campesinos!’s incredible chart-busting new album, All Hell. It's gain, it's lo-fi, it's saturation, it's tape, it's all hell.
